summary: Skip the full identity scan for proven locator additions

delivery.outcome: Keep queue discovery responsive during an incremental archive update when a verified prior locator makes a full identity scan unnecessary.
nonGoals: Changing canonical ticket precedence, discovery contracts, deployment admission or the repair budgets.

architecture.decision: Use the validated saved locator to identify additions into changed sources. Keep the existing conservative verification for remaps, removals, unknown baselines and removed shards.
architecture.rollback: Revert the source change. The index schema and repair budgets are unchanged.

validation.evidence: A cold archive update with a verified locator succeeds while the full identity query is forbidden.
The existing duplicate precedence, unrelated locator removal and shard rotation cases remain green.
